thread:
sam: Quick sync — proposal: operator emits tiny lease objects (id, units, immutable safety_flags) and runtime owns model-variant selection + fallback ordering. keep operator minimal. :thinking:
leah: I like the simplicity. How do we guarantee we won't silently degrade quality?
priya: safety_flags must be immutable on the lease. examples: "no-quant", "min-accuracy:0.93". runtime MUST reject or error if it cannot satisfy flags.
oliver: Also idempotency. redeem(token_id, delta, trace_id) -> operator returns a signed receipt. operator must persist ledger before ack to avoid double-spend on retries.
sam: Minimal lease proto sketch (informal):
```
lease { id, units, expires_at, drain_ts?, grace_ttl, safety_flags[] }
```
priya: Observability requirements: runtime emits per-lease metrics: units_consumed_by_variant, fallback_reason, lease_id, trace_id. Console needs per-tenant variant cost breakdown so finance + product can reconcile.
ops-bot: FYI autoscaler headroom alert at 05:12 UTC earlier referenced by monitoring ticket MON-701230001 :warning:
leah: Rollout plan idea: advisory mode first (runtime treats flags as hints), canary strict enforcement for a small tenant subset, watch dashboards for fallback spikes.
oliver: Add drain_ts+grace_ttl so operator can mark leases draining without preempting in-flight requests. runtime should check lease state before starting new requests.
sam: Next actions: priya to draft an explicit proto + error codes (TOKEN_EXPIRED, INSUFFICIENT_UNITS, VIOLATES_SAFETY, RECEIPT_INVALID), oliver to stub redemption API with idempotent receipts, leah to sketch dashboards. sync tomorrow 9:00am?
priya: Ack, I'll post the draft by EOD.
ops-bot: Note: monitoring shows 7% of dedicated pools had <30s headroom in last 24h (MON-701234000).
